Definition: Ira, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ira is the name of three men who served David, and the Bible keeps them apart by their fathers and their towns. In 2 Samuel 20:26 Ira the Jairite is chief ruler about David, in 2 Samuel 23:26 Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite stands among the mighty men, and in 1 Chronicles 11:28 the same Ira the son of Ikkesh is listed again.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the three Iras show how the kingdom ran: a ruler, a mighty man, and a captain of the course, all serving the same king.
RelatedPeople: Ira the Jairite; Ira, Son of Ikkesh; King David
